attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd cluster (v3.4.30, Ubuntu apt package) across node1/node2/node3 using static bootstrap over their private IPs. Verified cross-member read/write consistency, demonstrated continued availability while node3 was stopped, confirmed node3 caught up after restart, then performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with proven boot-identity changes and full post-restart data/cluster-health verification.
